shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite food is sushi and ramen.
I usually walk my dog in the evening.
Traveling to new places makes me happy.
I enjoy playing basketball with my friends.
Cooking dinner on weekends is a fun activity.
Listening to music helps me focus while studying.
I prefer to ride a bike instead of driving a car.
Winter is my favorite season for its beauty and snow.
Volunteering at the local shelter brings me joy and satisfaction.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What kind of exercises do you enjoy doing?
Q2: Have you faced any challenges in maintaining a regular exercise routine?
Q3: How important do you think exercise is for overall health?
Q4: What advice would you give someone starting an exercise program?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about reading habits.
questions: Q1: How often do you read books or articles?
Q2: What difficulties do you encounter when trying to find time to read?
Q3: In your opinion, why is reading important in today's world?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone who wants to read more?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: What is your most memorable travel experience?
Q2: What challenges have you faced while traveling abroad?
Q3: How do you think travel impacts a person's perspective?
Q4: What tips would you offer to someone planning their first trip?
